title: An orientation tour of Central Station

turns.speaker: Guide
turns.text: Welcome to Central Station. You are standing in the main hall, just inside the south doors. We’ll start with a few directions before visiting the control room. The information desk used to be by the entrance, but it now stands beside the ticket machines.

turns.speaker: Guide
turns.text: On your left is a passage to the platforms. Platforms one and two are reached directly from the hall. For platform three, use the footbridge. There is a lift at both ends of the bridge, so travellers with large bags do not have to take the stairs.

turns.speaker: Guide
turns.text: The public toilets are downstairs. The accessible toilet is on this level, opposite the café. The café is closed for cleaning until eleven, but there’s a drinking fountain near the ticket machines.

turns.speaker: Guide
turns.text: A small museum occupies the old station office on the first floor. Please do not go there yet. We are meeting its curator in the waiting room at quarter past eleven, and she will take us upstairs together.

turns.speaker: Guide
turns.text: At noon we will visit the control room. Please leave bags in the lockers beside the waiting room. You can keep notebooks and pencils with you. Photography is allowed later in the museum, but not in the control room.

turns.speaker: Guide
turns.text: If we are separated, meet in the main hall at the end of the tour. There is a clock above the south doors. It is a better meeting point than the information desk, which is usually crowded just before the lunchtime trains.

questions.explanation: Thông tin được đổi từ lối vào sang cạnh máy bán vé.

questions.explanation: Đường ra platform three đi qua cầu bộ hành.

questions.explanation: Chỉ được chụp trong bảo tàng.
